bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on multiple-choice QA benchmarks (BLEnD, NORMAD) testing everyday cultural knowledge and social norms across different countries, and conducting human evaluations of open-ended story generation to measure cultural fluency and familiarity.

Using the SeeGULL stereotype avoidance benchmark, a multiple-choice test where the model is prompted with a stereotypic trait and must choose 'unsure' instead of falsely associating the trait with a specific national identity.
